fusions.name: Mark the Spot
fusions.desc: Throws a needle that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pierce the Iris
fusions.desc: A needle thrown at a target up to 7 tiles away for 18 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Narrowed Pupil
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Seen Where It Opens
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
